hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; RESULT=$(cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then echo "$RESULT"; else cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'Cerebro: no brain initialized for this project. Run: cerebro init'; fi

COUNT=$(cerebro recall --prime --format md -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^## [0-9a-f]\{8\} \["); if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "Cerebro online. %d memories loaded."}' "$COUNT"; else printf '{"systemMessage": "Cerebro: no brain initialized. Run: cerebro init"}'; fi

[ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; cerebro hook post-compact -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null

[ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; cerebro hook post-compact -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null

[ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; cerebro hook post-compact -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null
cerebro hook post-compact -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; echo "$(date -Iseconds) compaction completed" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-compact.log" 2>/dev/null; true
